title: NarrativeOS reference study (what was measured in one reference video)
description: Measurements and observations only. The reference's footage, frames, words and transcript never enter the repo (CLAUDE.md rights rules); they stay in NarrativeOS-Data/analysis/<id>/ on the owner's machine.

creator.description: Channel or author, as credited on the source.

owner_supplied_file.description: The owner gave a local file; the media itself is not kept in the repo.

kind.description: story_documentary, science_documentary, documentary_short, code_art, profile_edit, template_edit, own_film, ...

used_for.description: Channels or projects this study informs, e.g. AVEN.

excerpt.description: start-end seconds when only part was measured

tools.description: Capability ids that produced the measurements (catalog/capabilities.json).

measurements.description: MEASURED numbers by department (picture, sync, sound, ...), each from a named tool.

observations.description: OBSERVED (looked at frames) or INFERRED statements, each labelled in its text.

labels.description: How to read the evidence labels (MEASURED / OBSERVED / INFERRED).

findings_doc.description: Repo-relative path of the written findings.

local_data.description: Where the full local analysis (with frames) lives, relative to NARRATIVEOS_HOME.
